cloud.title: Cloud account
cloud.description: Sign in with your Berlin Green app account. Only the sign-in token is stored, not the password; Google/Apple sign-in is not supported. The cloud is read-only. `tools/extract_key.py` reads the app's API key from the app file (APK/XAPK), see the instructions in the repository.

data_description.api_key: Starts with AIza and is 39 characters long.

error.invalid_api_key: The API key is invalid or restricted to the app. It starts with AIza and is 39 characters long.

abort.no_devices_found: No GreenBox found. Close the phone app and move a Bluetooth adapter/proxy closer.
